message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "---
name: Lint

on:
  merge_group:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # =====================================================================
  # Primary Lint job
  # =====================================================================
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@630ae543ea3a38a9a4166f03376c02c50f408342 # v31
        with:
          nix_path: nixpkgs=channel:nixos-unstable

      - name: Run flake pre-commit hooks
        run: nix develop -c pre-commit run --all-files",
  "rationale": "The workflow runs a single lint job on pull_request (opened/synchronize/reopened) and merge_group. Repeated pushes to a PR (synchronize) re-run the job while an older run for the same PR may still be in progress, duplicating work. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE supports canceling superseded runs for the same workflow and branch/PR, reducing duplicate VM time while always letting the latest revision run to completion, so build/test coverage and the required check result are preserved. Concurrency is scoped per workflow and ref (github.head_ref for pull requests, falling back to github.ref) so distinct branches/PRs do not share a cancellation group, respecting the pattern contraindication. No permissions, secrets, privileged actions, publishing/deployment, or new network access are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}

The user wants me to propose a CI optimization for the given workflow based on evidence. Let me analyze the workflow and evidence.

```yaml
  # =====================================================================

    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:

      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@630ae543ea3a38a9a4166f03376c02c50f408342 # v31
        with:
          nix_path: nixpkgs=channel:nixos-unstable

      - name: Run flake pre-commit hooks
        run: nix develop -c pre-commit run --all-files
```

This is a single job "lint" that runs on ubuntu-latest, checks out code, installs nix, and runs pre-commit hooks via nix develop.

Available evidence patterns:

2. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST - matrix fail-fast, not applicable (no matrix).
